thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — P0 routing spike auto-closed at 2026-03-14T22:10Z. Root cause flagged as cascading client retries after a broken health-check header landed in a canary deploy. Paging history attached to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

Kai: I was primary oncall. Quick summary: traffic spike + retries bumped router CPU, KV cache thrashing, ~2.3s median tail latency on inference, some 502s. Rolled back canary at +18m, scaled router pool, cleared KV cache. Customer impact window ~21:34–21:52 UTC.

Kai: CC @Maria — want a formal postmortem timeline and owner assignment. I left a raw timeline in the doc: https://notion.redwood/incident/1976543210 (please add participant notes).

Maria: Thanks Kai. I'll own the postmortem. Scheduling: can we target doc draft by EOD tomorrow and a dry run with CS on Monday? Also want a short exec blurb for support tickets.

Jordan: FYI we already saw 4 enterprise customers open severity tickets. Working with CS to route responses. I'll add customer-specific impact notes to the doc. If anyone has request IDs or example traces please paste them here.

Priya: Saved a few quick runbook gaps observed while triaging:
- no explicit check for malformed health-check headers in canary gating
- retry-burst protection not applied to router->backend path
- KV eviction thresholds were conservative for that traffic pattern

Priya: Proposed runbook snippet to add under "Deploy gating":
```
# canary health gating check (pseudo)
if avg_success_rate(health_check, canary) < 99%:
    abort_deploy("canary failed health check: rate below threshold")

if retry_rate(backend) > 5%:
    pause_traffic()
    notify(oncall)
```

Samir: I'll take the KV tuning and follow-up testing. Will run a replay against stage and report perf numbers. Target: config baked + test results in 48h. @Maria assign to me in the action tracker please.

Maria: Assigned: Samir -> KV thresholds and replay (due 48h). Priya -> Runbook edits (due 24h). Kai -> compile timeline + logs (due 12h). Jordan -> Customer impact notes & CS blurb (due 24h). I'll produce the draft postmortem after those items land.

Kai: Hand-off note: I'm handing to Jordan for overnight oncall at 22:30 UTC. Jordan — you have the incident slack thread and doc link. If anything pages, escalate to @Maria directly.

Jordan: Confirmed handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and watch for regression alerts. Added a short watch query: `sum(rate(router_errors[1m])) by (region)` and an alert rule to 2x baseline.

Priya: Small follow-up suggestion for the runbook section "Immediate mitigation": add explicit steps to clear KV prefix and a safe order for router restart to avoid thundering herd. Example text included in the doc.

Samir: Quick note on testing: I'll include a golden trace and the `--replay-rps` settings I used. Will also test the retry throttling patch in a feature branch.

Maria: Action item summary posted to the incident doc (Checklist section). Please update the tracker with PR links when you open them. We'll schedule a 30m postmortem review 48–72h after this thread if remediation tasks are on track.

Kai: Thanks team. A couple of learnings to capture: prefer conservative deploy gating for router-facing header changes; enable retry-burst protection by default on new routes; and we should add an oncall runbook play for "canary health header mismatch".

Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll also create a short runbook card in the ops board and link from the postmortem.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: postmortem-review meeting in 60h if action items remain open. :calendar:
